generations.conceptPrompt: A 1989 police radio dispatch desk set for a small-town station in Eastern Europe: a low wide console that sits on a desk, with a sloping button panel, a speaker, a handset in a cradle and a stubby desk microphone. Cream plastic cabinet with brown side panels, a sloping panel of piano-style channel keys and indicator lamps, a speaker grille, a handset on the right, a desk microphone. Single object, orthographic-style three-quarter product shot from slightly above, the whole object in frame, plain flat light grey background, soft even studio light, no hands, no stand, no text, no logos, no watermark.
